title: Co-op checks 3: given arrows weigh nothing only for their carrier, a real downed pawn with the game's own chime (DPC 0.9.172-dev32)
intro: Two controllers, both awake. A full party (Arisen, player 2's Archer pawn, at least one more pawn), out of combat. Playing the Arisen, co-op off. Each step lasts until you press End (keyboard).

settings.label: Give a played Archer missing special arrows
Our own down notice (off: the game's chime only)

probes.mode: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.cp and ((D.R.cp.on and D.R.cp.mode) or (D.coop.active and 'classic') or 'off')
probes.errs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json'); return ok and d and d.errors
probes.given: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.arrow_give.given or 0
probes.kg: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; local G = D and D.R.arrow_give; local s = ''; if G and G.kg then for k, v in pairs(G.kg) do s = s .. tostring(k) .. '=' .. string.format('%.2f', v) .. ' ' end end; return s
probes.w_pawn: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; local im = sdk.get_managed_singleton('app.ItemManager'); local c = D and D.state.pawn_chara; if not (im and c) then return -1 end; return im:call('getStorageWeight(app.Character)', c)
probes.w_arisen: local im = sdk.get_managed_singleton('app.ItemManager'); local cm = sdk.get_managed_singleton('app.CharacterManager'); local c = cm and cm:call('get_ManualPlayer'); if not (im and c) then return -1 end; return im:call('getStorageWeight(app.Character)', c)
probes.dead: local pm = sdk.get_managed_singleton('app.PawnManager'); local l = pm and pm:call('get_PawnCharacterList'); if not l then return 0 end; local n = 0; for i = 0, l:call('get_Count') - 1 do local c = l:call('get_Item', i); if c and c:call('get_IsDead') then n = n + 1 end end; return n

steps.text: Get ready (see the intro). Press End.
PLAYER 2: hold L3 + R3 until co-op starts (player 1 the Arisen, player 2 the Archer pawn).

WEIGHT: the Archer gets any missing special arrow. Open the Archer's equipment/bag and look at the weight and weight class: they should be the same as before the arrows arrived. Then check another pawn or the Arisen carrying arrows: those still weigh what they normally do. End when done.

expect.label: Archer's carried weight as the game reads it

steps.text: DOWN: one of the other pawns is knocked down now. He should fall and lie there like a real downed pawn, with the game's own chime and flash (our red line is off). PLAYER 1: revive him straight away. End when done.
Done. PLAYER 1: hold L3 + R3 for 3 seconds to end co-op. Tell Claude: did the weight class stay put, did the pawn fall, chime?
